title: Venezulan Vegan Paella
description: A vegan twist on the classic Spanish paella dish, using Venezulan rice and adding nutty flavors.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat.
Add 2 tablespoons of oil and sauté the crispy rice until browned.
Add the Venezulan rice, nutty flavors, and paella seasoning. Stir well.
Cook for 5 minutes or until the rice is lightly toasted.
Add 2 cups of vegetable broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes or until the liquid is absorbed.
Fluff the paella with a fork and serve hot.
Garnish with additional nutty flavors if desired.
